prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: standalone high resolution illustrative construction detail photograph for Tomoroga Construct website.
Primary request: Create one clean edge-to-edge landscape photograph approximately 1600 by 1200 pixels matching ONLY the closeup steel connection photograph at the lower left of the supplied full website composition. A dark charcoal structural steel I-beam is attached by a heavy steel plate and large hexagonal bolts to a textured pale concrete column. Main bolt group centered near 55 percent of image width and 42 percent of image height. Main beam extends diagonally from the connection toward the upper right edge. The rough concrete vertical column occupies the central-left portion, another concrete horizontal beam extends from the left behind the connection, and background structural beams recede diagonally with small patches of blue sky visible at the right and bottom.
Input image: supplied full website design is only a reference for this steel-connection photograph's crop, angle and material textures. Recreate the photo cleanly, removing all numbered circular hotspot overlays.
Composition: close upward-looking crop, strong geometric beam diagonals, large visible bolted connection, 4:3 aspect ratio.
Style/medium: highly realistic professional architectural detail photography. Warm natural daylight creates crisp readable steel flange and bolt shadows. Sharp surface detail in dark painted steel and granular concrete, natural neutral colours.
Constraints: exactly one standalone photograph, physically plausible construction. No page layout, UI, text, numbers, letters, captions, logos, watermarks, hotspot markers, circles, annotations or graphic overlays. Illustrative concept, not an actual company project.
